I did my Open Water certification here as a solo traveler and had the BEST experience. From start to finish, the whole team made me feel supported, safe, and genuinely welcomed.

Amp was my instructor and was absolutely incredible. From dive 1 through dive 4, he always made sure I felt comfortable, confident, and calm in the water. He explained everything clearly, never rushed me, and really helped build my confidence with each dive.

Tammy was also amazing she was so communicative and helpful from the very beginning. She answered every question I had quickly and thoroughly, which made the whole process smooth and stress free.

I originally chose this dive school because of the great reviews, and now I completely understand why. The marine life was amazing on my dives and the people on this team are truly one of a kind. I couldn’t have asked for a better first diving certification experience. Highly, highly recommend! 🙏❤️

We had an amazing experience with this club ! My friend was beginner and the instructor was very nice with her. Special thanks at Amorn ! Best instructor ! We had a wonderful time. We could book the day before a bit late and they were super reactive. Pick up and drop off at our hotel included :) Thanks again ! We will come to dive with you again !

Amazing experience with Amorn!! Me and my friends went diving for the first time terrified of what’s to come and amorn was super patient and easy going to work with. Gave us the best techniques and was patient- would highly recommend to anybody visiting krabi to choose him!!

This was really and truly incredible experience with those guys Gig done fantastic job taken me through level one Open water diving certificate,  all crew , Mr Wii boat guys and dive master Amp super fun could find better school to go for .
Next time I come back Krabi I definitely put my money on this crew, small boat just 6 people max
Very professional big hugs,  well done

I did the PADI open water with the instructor at the start of the monsoon season, and had a fantastic experience! I was taken care of very well, with transport to and from the hotel for each part of the training, had food at each stage, and the paperwork for the licence was addressed on the same day. All communication was fast and responsive through WhatsApp, including paying for deposit and on site admin. The diving instructor was very helpful, answered all my question, and did everything in English. Would definitely do another licence with Scuba Expert Krabi, it was everything I wanted and more.

Very professionsal and well planned. It was my first experience scuba diving and our instructor was very experienced. He was calm and very vigilant. Couldn’t have asked for a better first diving experience.

First diving with Teacher (Mr.Amorn ).He is kindness & very good teacher i really reccommend to study with him!

his team also good when go to opensea.

👌👌♥️♥️
The most worthwhile experience!! The instructor (Mr. Amorn) was very kind and professional. He took care of me from the first training until the fun underwater dive. Thank you very much kha.🙏🏻🤿✨ …

Amorn is an amazing guide who made me feel secure when I felt scared. He helped me through the whole experience and I am so thankful!!

Had DSD double with Suki, knowledgeable, good and caring instructor, always checked underwater if everything is good. overall Very good experience, though visibility was not so great, we managed to see a lot of beautiful fish and corals. Also we had Amorn and Amp instructors, who are very funny and helpful. Recommend diving with this guys. Better text them in WhatsApp directly for booking

What a fabulous experience.  The entire crew ensured you were comfortable and had fun. Amorn was just superb.. he took care of my mum (Age 72) like his own.. we felt very safe, assured and comfortable! A definite!

I went to this place on Sunday and the lady was so polite to let us enter and book us for the next day.

They have an extremely professional team.

We were 5 people and they take Booking of only 6 people at once.

It was my first time doing scuba and our group opted for 1 day and 2 dive in local Krabi sites.

The payment procedure was very smooth. And kudos to the lady who answered all our questions and doubts very smoothly and provided us with photographs and videos.

Thank you for beautiful memories.

I went for a day with these guys yesterday. It was first class. From the very point of booking through Angela in the office to the welcome on the drive boat with Thomas it was excellent. Stephen was my instructor needs a special mention. He was a great communicator, patient and very experienced in his trade and made me feel confident with the two dives that we did. Thank you! Diving can be a dangerous activity in the wrong hands. These guys know exactly what they are doing to make it a fun and memorable day. Many thanks. Mark

We saw google reviews and went for enquiry about scuba dive for 1day which is near to our booked resort in Krabi with several companies. We found this one is wonderful with budget friendly and safety.

Initially me nd my husband were scared to take scuba since we are not expert swimmers in ocean. But they were very friendly and the lady answered all of our questions and showed so many videos and photos who went scuba dive without knowing swimming.

Then we booked immediately and given the location of resort. They have arranged Pick up and drop for hotel. Pick up was exactly at 8:30 am.They took only 6 people including us to local islands for 2 dive spots.

For the first dive, initially I was scared to go inside but Amon (Scuba master) was very helpful he calm down my tension and taken inside exactly more than 8m depth. We were vey happy with our first dive. Only thing we should control our ear pressure difference inside of the deepest water.

Plenty of snacks, fruits and water arranged for us.

We were confident and went for second dive with 9.5m with 38min timing. Amon is having the scuba timer so he was very cautious that how much depth he has to take us as beginners. Along with Amon one more person will be available for take us to back to the boat.

All Scuba expert team is so supportive and friendly. Special thanks to Amon 🙏 for these wonderful experience.

These are all permanent memories in our hearts♥️

We wanted to support a local Thai dive company and I am happy we chose Scuba Expert for both our dive days. We met Oumn and she was very knowledgeable and very experienced. Our divemaster - Big, was the best ar spotting nudibranches. Absolutely enjoyed our time with them. Will come back and dive with them again as they are the only FULLY THAI OPERATED DIVE COMPANY IN KRABI ❤️❤️

Was out on a private Diving tour at Phi Phi island, one of the best Diving experiences I've ever had. Instructor was amazing, very professional and I felt safe the whole time.
Crew on the boat took great care of me and my girlfriend, great food and fruits!
We also got some time to snorkel and the experience was 10/10.
I highly recommend them while visiting Krabi in Thailand.
Amorn was a great dive leader, helped make the experience even more fun! Got to see lion shark and showed us all different fishes. Was a very nice chilled boat! Best diving in krabi
Amazing experience, very friendly and fun professionals, beautiful water. What else can a person ask for when diving. Definitely worth the visit 👋👋 …

Ohm and Amon are such amazing people! We feel like we made friends here. They helped us even with hotel recommendations, tourist recommendations and food. We had the best experience diving with them. They always keep it light but at the same time make sure you learn and have a great diving experience! Cannot recommend them enough.

Nice experience! Been a couple years since I went diving so followed my guide in the water. Beautiful spots with lots of marine life. Upbeat dive guys, and they listened to my need for coffee before heading out. They took care of everything, helped all of us get into our gear and into and out of the boat. Very attentive.

Only problem for me was I had to pee so bad it hurt, and I TRIED to go in the ocean but was still having some kind of weird mental block, I couldn't go!

Regardless this was at the end of the trip and the boat captain stepped on it on the way back for me. It wasn't their fault, but.. you know, no toilet on the boat fair warning.

Cannot recommend this company enough! We had the best day ever, an amazing experience. The staff/instructors are so friendly and lovely and made the experience one to remember! 🙌🏽 the dive spots were incredible (we saw so much sea life, and were lucky enough to see a turtle) the equipment was clean and well looked after, they provide a vegan/ vegetarian lunch if you want one too!!😊 loved every second of it 🐙🐬🐠🐡🦑🐳!

The guides are very professional, very attentive to divers and nature. They know good and not crowded places with a lot of marine life. The equipment is in very good condition. The management is very flexible and ready to help in various situations.
Amorn is a spectacular guide. Enjoyed both dives. It was my wife’s second dive, he was patient, clear, funny and worried about safety. We had an incredible time.

I obtained my OW license from this shop. My instructor Amorn is very knowledgeable and experienced professional diver. He started diving at age 17 and have 18 years teaching experiences. I’m really glad to have him teach me everything and make the studying engaging.

Very recommend for Scuba learning and day trip. High experiences from staffs, approx. 15+ yrs of Scuba diving. Staffs are friendly and take good care of divers. If you are looking for Scuba in Krabi, this place will be the best choice 👍👍 …

We have been staying in Ao Nang for few days and after looking around for a decent scuba diving company who offered a good quality/price ratio and expert instructors, when we came across Scuba Expert (Krabi).

We were a group of 6 people and we had a wonderful day! They offered pick up from our hotel and lunch/snacks.
The diving experience was amazing, we saw a lot of fishes, corals and so on! The best we was were stingrays, turtles and moraines.
Both instructors (Amon and Ohm) were amazing.. very patient and expert divers!
With their initial teaching, they managed to break the ice with funny jokes and positive attitude, which made us feel safer (especially for beginners like us).

The food provided was local and was amazing! We did plenty of boat tours that offered food on board but nothing like this company. They also included soft drinks, fruit and vegetarian/vegan options (to be asked in advance).

We would definely recommended it! :)

Very good school and better instructors. I took open water and my husband advance diving with Amorn, very easygoing person, funny, patient and with very good explanations. Three amazing days, we learnt a lot. Recommended!!!!!!!!!!

The most surreal experience with expert diving. All the staff are amazing people with a great sense of humour. Amp explained everything so clearly and taught us a lot of new skills. We did the local island dive and I recommend this. Thank you expert dive for such a great day! We hope to return soon 😁 …
very serious, I recommend for PADI training or fun diving. the instructors are competent and the equipment is of good quality, great dives with them. Thanks a lot!🙏 …

We went diving scuba expert. Amon was a great guide. He took my son diving and they had two great dives in one of the most picturesque settings in the world. Then he helped me on my first dive; it was only for a few minutes and shallow but I loved every minute of it.  Thank you Amon and Scuba Experts for an amazing day!

We have been using Scuba Expert for many years now. This Thai-owned company is exceptionally well run, and the staff are incredibly caring. Our 12-year-old son recently completed his advanced course and went out just with the boat crew and …

I like diving. Even a bad dive can be a good day. But when it’s a good dive by a good crew then it’s a great dive. Amorn and his team made it easy so I could enjoy without any hassles. And the pictures they take along the way and shared at the end of the trip were brilliant.
Amazing experience! Very friendly instructors and divers. Had a great team. I highly recommend Big! Honest and brings lots of fun! Long boat could be a bit of hard work but overall highly recommend.

Absolutely amazing day, Amorn and Wee were just the best undersea guides and coaches. It was my son and daughter’s first dive and they are hooked. Thanks guys for an amazing time
Simon Kelly David Chloe & Aiden

Wee (our dive instructor) was absolutely brilliant! Our birthday girl got to see a seahorse! All the staff were absolutely epic from start to finish. Would highly recommend!

- Ross, Lucy, Eli, & AJ

We had a fantastic two days diving with Scuba Experts. What an amazing crew, very knowledgeable, safe and friendly! I would highly recommend that anyone dive with this shop when in Krabi! I will be back for sure.

Wouldn't dive with anybody else out of Krabi. The guides knew the best places to go day by day and made sure everybody had a good, safe time. They met with us the day before our planned dives to fit all our gear to ensure that everything was good before we even got to the boat. The boys all had unique and fun personalities that shone through while keeping safety first. Which is what SCUBA should be all about!

My bf and I booked a "try scuba diving" experience, and it was a lot of fun. There were one other couple and another girl on the boat that day. The couple is doing a PADI course, the girl has done this for like 50 times already so she is super experienced. This was our first time diving, so it was also super cool to talk with them about their experiences.

3 coaches went with us that day: Ame, Big and Ohm.

Ame is obviously the patient, wise teacher type. He is fluent in English, and is very expressive and responsible. He makes sure all details are clear.

Big is the funny one. He is so energetic and happy all the time and can jump around on the boat even when it's super bumpy. It's almost like a super power.

And this is a special shout out to Ohm, our life guard in the ocean. He is friendly, patient, and kind. He takes super good pictures under the water for us and carried us around the whole time.

I just have 2 advice for people who want to try this for the first time:

1. Take motion sickness pills one day before or at least 1 hour before!! If you don't know if you will get seasick, think if you get carsick and if you do, you'll get seasick for sure. I didn't take pills so I threw up three times. It was embarrassing and painful... You should also google how to throw up while scuba diving btw, because it could be dangerous.

2. Take some clothes for changing because your clothes could get wet and it will be cold after the dives if you don't have dry clothes. Take an extra towel as well if you can.

Otherwise have fun!!! And sorry Ohm that i threw up on you in the sea...🙈🙈🙈
